title: Young Actors Theater

services.name: Conservatory Classes
services.desc: Looking to build rhythm, coordination, and confidence? Tap 1 is the perfect introduction to the fundamentals of tap dance. Students will develop strong technical basics through fun and structured exercises, while learning how to connect movement to music with precision and style. With upbeat combos and a high-energy atmosphere, this class is a great foundation for dancers -and a whole lot of fun along the way! Take your tap skills to the next level! In Tap 2, dancers will build on their foundational technique with more intricate rhythms, faster footwork, and exciting new combinations. This class focuses on musicality, precision, and performance quality-all while keeping the fun and energy

services.desc: Arts education at any age has the powerful ability to change lives.
